transcript:
WEBVTT

1
00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:06.000
Casey Demo: Thanks for making time. What does month-end look like today?

2
00:00:06.500 --> 00:00:14.000
Riley Example: We close in nine days. Most of that is chasing approvals over email.

3
00:00:14.500 --> 00:00:19.000
Riley Example: We looked at Sample Close last year but it was too rigid for us.

4
00:00:19.500 --> 00:00:24.000
Casey Demo: Who else would weigh in on a change like this?

5
00:00:24.500 --> 00:00:31.000
Riley Example: Our CFO signs off on anything over ten thousand a year.

6
00:00:31.500 --> 00:00:36.000
Casey Demo: I'll send a short write-up you can forward to your CFO.

7
00:00:36.500 --> 00:00:39.000
Riley Example: Great, thanks.
